# Architecture Solution Design

**LOCKED.** Do not edit this file. Propose changes in your reply instead.

This repo produces one document, `ADS.md`: an Architecture Solution Design. The
project is not known in advance. It is defined by the outcome statement recorded
through `/outcome` and by `inputs/context.md`, and by nothing else. There is no
application code here. The document is built the way
software is built: in phases, each on its own branch, checked by a script,
reviewed by a human, merged by PR.

@docs/architecture.md
@docs/conventions.md

## Read before any work

1. `docs/plan.md`: the phases, their status, and what each must produce.
2. `inputs/ADS_template.md`: the specification of what each section must contain.
   Read the sections for your phase in full.
3. `inputs/context.md` and everything under `inputs/discovery/`: the only source of
   project-specific facts.
4. All merged files in `ads/` and all of `registers/`: later phases build on the
   IDs and decisions of earlier ones.

`inputs/example/` holds a sample ADS for an unrelated project. Consult it for depth
and format only. It is never a source of content (G-11).

## Step 1: the outcome test

Nothing is generated until a business outcome statement has passed `/outcome` and
is recorded in `registers/decisions.md`. If asked to start a phase without one,
stop and say so. Never repair a failing statement yourself; ask for the
underlying goal.

## The loop

One phase at a time, in order. Never start phase N+1 while phase N is unmerged.

1. `/phase N` creates branch `phase/NN-slug` from an up-to-date `main`, writes
   `ads/NN-slug.md`, updates the registers and `docs/plan.md`, and runs
   `python3 scripts/ads.py check` until it passes.
2. **Stop.** Report the file path, the reviewer brief, and any questions. Do not
   commit, push or open a PR.
3. The human reads the file. Requested changes are made in the same file on the
   same branch, the check is re-run, and you stop again.
4. Only when the human explicitly approves, `/phase-done` commits, pushes, opens the
   PR, waits for CI, squash-merges, and returns to `main`.

Approval means words like "approved", "OK to merge" or `/phase-done` in the
human's latest message. Silence, a question, or approval of an earlier draft is not
approval.

## Hard rules

- Follow every rule in `docs/architecture.md`. The invariants I-1 to I-11 and the
  generation rules G-1 to G-11 are not negotiable inside a phase.
- Never invent project-specific facts, and never carry any over from the example. Use the provenance forms in G-3.
- Never edit locked paths: `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `inputs/**`,
  `scripts/**`, `.github/**`, `.claude/**`. Never hand-edit `ADS.md`.
- Never push to `main`, force-push, or merge with failing checks.
- Never weaken a check to make it pass. If the check is wrong, stop and say so.
- When the human answers an open question in chat, record it as a new `DEC-nnn` row
  in `registers/decisions.md` (owner: the human, basis: "review of phase N"), mark
  the `OQ` resolved with that `DEC`, and replace the matching `TBD` with
  `[src: DEC-nnn]`.
- When you discover a gap the rules do not cover, stop and escalate (G-8).

## Commands

```
python3 scripts/ads.py check     validate; run before every stop
python3 scripts/ads.py status    progress by phase
python3 scripts/ads.py build     assemble ADS.md (phase 10 only)
```
